text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...*pant*, *pant*. Tachyon-chan! I ran a 
full lap around the track holding the 
chest expander!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your cooperation, Dantsu-kun! 
Changes in running form when upper body 
tension is engaged... Fufufu, this 
promises to be magnificent research data!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Sheesh, you're using Dantsu as your 
personal guinea pig like always, Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you... thank her for once? If 
she decides never to help you again... I 
won't be feeling sorry for you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Indeed, that would be quite 
troublesome. Horse girls as usef—*cough*, 
as wonderfully cooperative as Dantsu-kun 
are truly a rare find, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you're looking for a present 
for Dantsu-san...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. But I'm having a veeeery difficult 
time deciding, you see~ ...Shall we drop 
by a bookstore next? There are some books 
I'd like to purchase myself, after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—For real?! You've been doing nothing but 
looking out for yourself this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, choosing Dantsu-kun's gift is 
indeed my top priority. However... there 
are so many shops, you see. It is purely 
coincidental when my own interests happen 
to overlap.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In that case, allow us to introduce some 
shops to you. We two were just touring 
around the brand-name stores, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, not a bad proposal at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—The wind resistance shouldn't be too 
significant. As for how the slacks affect 
muscular movement... Dantsu-kun, could you 
run for me in these clothes later?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ho, these Japanese sweets are high in 
carbohydrates, making them quite enticing 
from an energy replenishment perspective. 
Though I would love to observe cellular 
changes when consumed post-race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! I've also been wanting to 
re-examine the effects of olfactory 
stimulation on racing performance! I'll 
need to conduct an experiment using 
perfume quite soon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me~~~ I can't decide at all, not 
one bit!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Did you ever have any intention of 
choosing?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're doing whatever the hell you want, 
as usual!! Dammit, I should've known you'd 
be like this...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Before deciding our next move, how about a 
meal? Operating brain cells that usually 
sit dormant has completely drained my 
energy reserves.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then how about fried chicken? There's 
a place right here in this mall!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm goin' with that! The wings 
here are seriously delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll set out the fries right here! 
...Ah, what should we do about the 
biscuits?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat 'em later! Come to think of it, 
the four of us hung out and ate like this 
before too, didn't we? When was that 
again?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That was last month... Dantsu-san was 
roped into one of Tachyon-san's 
experiments... An experiment investigating 
the effects of shoes, I believe...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, there was also a time 
when Pokke-kun wouldn't stop fussing about 
wanting taiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That was last week, right? Right after 
helping with the nutritional analysis!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Man, Dantsu, you help out way too much. 
You know you can spend more time on 
yourself, right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... But whenever I'm helping, you two 
always come over to check on me without 
fail!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, ya know, we just get curious what's 
going on. Cafe and I were worried about 
ya, obviously!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you're all such great friends! It 
feels like you're always together.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I just realized. I've already received 
tons and tons of presents.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
? We haven't bought you anything yet, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, I've been receiving them since way 
back! And even right now—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for today! 
...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day on my day off, while strolling 
through the shopping mall, I spotted some 
horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
We've had such a wonderful day off, 
haven't we?
choice_data_list: Were you all hanging out together today?
Were you all hanging out together today?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
We've had such a wonderful day off, 
haven't we?
choice_data_list: Were you all hanging out together today?
Were you all hanging out together today?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We walked all over the mall with 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
We promised to go hang out together again 
sometime... Fufu, I wonder where we should 
go next.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. We just bumped into them by 
chance! But... it really made me feel how 
wonderful Dantsu-san and the others are 
today.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Buena-san. In that case... Why don't we 
stay and have some more fun too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
! ...Yeah! Since we're already here, let's 
hang out just a little longer!
